blockingFindings.description: V72 direct inspection of all five views and six pose renders, corroborated by Astra, still shows substantial anterior thigh exposure in sit and crouch as the overskirt panels lift and separate laterally. The front apron transition has not established continuous coverage.
Neutral front view retains a pronounced center-front split and pointed, uneven hem; the transition leaves the front silhouette visibly discontinuous.
Side and rear views retain strong accordion-like corrugation and rough seam transitions. The two-ring transition hypothesis did not resolve the drape.
The rear waist adjustment tab remains too small and faint to read at full-body scale.

The current topology/UV showcase is regenerated from the V72 build-source hash and reports PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED: 1/7 source-authored UV objects, 2 active layers with unverified provenance, and 4 unmapped objects. The showcase displays that state; no fallback or automatic UVs were generated.
